findings.title: Unrelated destructive edit to the PLANS.md task 5.3 status
findings.detail: Corrected. The task 5.3 status region of PLANS.md now matches commit dda74c7 exactly ('oversized-byte, oversized-dimension, unreadable, hash/length/surface correctness, oriented dimensions, supported non-local conversion, and boundary-neutrality checks'). A full line-range diff of PLANS.md against dda74c7 shows changes only at the project-status line, the Phase 5 position paragraph, the milestone table, the task 5.6 checkbox, and the added task 5.6 status block; no other task status (5.1/5.2/5.3/5.4) was altered.

findings.title: Present expectedBeforeIdentity/observedAfterIdentity need not carry a content hash
findings.detail: ArtworkOperation.Validate accepts a Present expectedBeforeIdentity or observedAfterIdentity with a null ContentSha256. This is fail-closed (ArtworkOwnershipComparer returns Unknown), but looser than PublishedArtworkState.Validate. Not an acceptance gap for 5.6; recovery in 5.7 will treat such records as OwnershipUnknown/RecoveryBlocked.

findings.title: A newer generation may overwrite an unreconciled non-terminal record
findings.detail: EnsureWriteIsFenced permits a strictly newer generation to replace a non-terminal record whose phase is MutationStarted or later; the store cannot reconcile it. This matches the documented monotonic-generation rule and the per-subject single-record invariant, but depends on 5.5/5.7/5.9 resolving a non-terminal operation before accepting a new generation. Flagged for downstream awareness.

findings.title: lastError sanitizer has no pattern-based secret detection
findings.detail: Sanitize only strips control/whitespace characters and truncates to 512 chars. The model stores no credential/path/raw-payload field and lastError is a caller-supplied already-redacted diagnostic, so this is acceptable, but it remains a caller contract rather than defence-in-depth.

findings.title: Two explicit presence fields added to data-model 3.10.3 beyond the flat field list
findings.detail: sourcePresence and candidateAfterPresence are justified and consistently applied: the pre-existing row text already referenced 'presence = Absent' and 'Required when source is present', which cannot be enforced without an explicit presence. It mirrors PublishedArtworkState.sourcePresence in 3.10.1. Validate enforces both.

findings.title: ownershipToken is required unconditionally
findings.detail: Data-model 3.10.3 marks ownershipToken 'Yes for an owned session', but Validate requires it on every operation. Stricter than the wording but safe for V1 and consistent with ADR-003 step 3.

findings.title: Minor imprecision in the 5.6 retention wording
findings.detail: Corrected. PLANS.md and docs/changelog.md now state that terminal retention eligibility derives solely from Phase (Committed/Aborted/RecoveryBlocked) and explicitly note that a tombstoned item-removal operation is terminal because its phase is Aborted, not because of its lifecycle fence.
